QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_21

question.text: Material changes in the PPM and fund documents of an AIF must be intimated to investors and SEBI on a consolidated basis:

answer.text: Within 1 month of the end of each financial year
Within 30 days of the change itself
Within 7 working days of the change
Immediately upon the change taking effect

explanation.text: The Logic: Changes in terms of the PPM and fund documents must be intimated to investors AND SEBI on a CONSOLIDATED basis within 1 month of the end of each financial year. The Trap: 7 days / 30 days / immediate-notice are fake distractors tied to different compliance regimes. The AIF Regulation uses a CONSOLIDATED annual cadence. Note: The workbook fixes the one-month-post-FYE consolidated reporting rule; investor-relations advice on proactive quarterly disclosures is not part of the syllabus.
